chunks.text:
Statins decrease your risk of having a stroke or heart attack because they cut down the amount of LDL (low-density lipoprotein or “bad”) cholesterol in your blood. Some statins can decrease your LDL cholesterol by 50% or more. LDL cholesterol can narrow your arteries (atherosclerosis), making it hard for your blood to circulate and putting you at risk for a heart attack or stroke.

Statins also reduce inflammation and slow plaque progression.

### What are the risks of taking statins? [...] Statin drugs lower your total and LDL cholesterol levels to make you less likely to have a heart attack or stroke. Your body uses cholesterol when it makes vitamin D, hormones and the acid you use to digest food. But if you have too much cholesterol in your blood, it can collect inside your arteries. This creates obstacles that make it harder for your blood to get through your blood vessels.

Advertisement [...] When you take statin drugs, your body makes less LDL cholesterol. And that means less cholesterol buildup in your arteries and better blood flow.

#### Dosage guidelines

Your healthcare provider will prescribe the dose that’s right for you. It could range from 1 milligram (mg) to 80 mg.

Statin drugs are tablets or capsules that you swallow whole with or without food. You should take them at the same time each day, usually once a day.

# 他汀类药物：这些降胆固醇药物是否适合您？

他汀类药物是可以降低胆固醇的药物。这类药物的作用原理是阻断人体产生胆固醇所需的某种物质。

降低胆固醇并不是使用他汀类药物的唯一益处。这些药物还与降低心脏病和卒中的风险有关。他汀类药物还可帮助降低特定类型血栓的风险。

美国可以使用若干种他汀类药物。这些药物包括：

有时，他汀类药物可以与其他心脏药物联合使用。例如，阿托伐他汀-氨氯地平（Caduet）和依折麦布-辛伐他汀（Vytorin）。

## 是否应服用他汀类药物？

是否需要服用他汀类药物取决于胆固醇水平和导致心血管疾病的其他风险因素。在开他汀类药物处方之前，医务人员会考虑导致心脏病发作和卒中的所有风险因素。

不妨先从了解您的胆固醇值开始。
